story: Unsportsmanlike Conduct, the house brand, benched Drake Maye (22/37, 269 yds, 3 TD, 54 rush yds, 26.16) in New England's 29-26 win at Buffalo, started Jalen Hurts (12/27, 93 yds, 13.52) and DeVonta Smith (no stat record, 0.00), and lost to WELL! It's The Big Shough by 13.72. Maye for Hurts alone is 12.64 and still loses by 1.08; add Quentin Johnston's 5.00 for Smith and UC wins by 3.92.

Micah parsons fan club started free-agent pickup Case Keenum at Superflex; he took 1 of 93 snaps (a 'ceremonial first pitch,' per ESPN) for 0.00, and Micah still beat Skat's BruteForce Theorem by 29.58 and moved to first in Elo at 1029.33. Then they swapped Keenum for Tyson Bagent, the quarterback who replaced him, for $0.
